truths.truth: A primary manifest with no `version` field halts the close: ok:false / action:"refuse" / reason:"no-version-field" at exit 1 with nothing written, while this repo's own manifest pair still bumps ok:true with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json as a sibling skip.
truths.evidence: Executed `node cadence-core/bin/release-bump.mjs bump --dir <fixture holding only .claude-plugin/plugin.json without a version field, plus a CHANGELOG> --version 2.0.0` -> {"ok":false,"action":"refuse","reason":"no-version-field","target":"2.0.0","manifest":{"from":null,"to":"2.0.0","bumped":false},"siblings":[],"changelog":{"changed":false,"state":"not-examined"},"detail":"the primary manifest .claude-plugin/plugin.json carries no `version` field..."}, EXIT=1; md5sum -c over both fixture files afterwards: OK / FILES UNCHANGED. Second half: copied this repo's real .claude-plugin/plugin.json (version 3.5.8) and marketplace.json into a fixture and ran `bump --version 99.0.0 --date 2026-08-22` -> {"ok":true,"action":"bumped",...,"siblings":[{"file":".claude-plugin/marketplace.json","action":"skip","bumped":false}],...}, EXIT=0. Implementation and wiring: cadence-core/bin/release-bump.mjs:298-309 arm; pinned by cadence-core/bin/release-bump.test.mjs:409-429 (rewritten from the old `skips` test, the only deletion in that file's phase diff) and :431-456; both green under `node --test cadence-core/bin/release-bump.test.mjs` (40/40 pass, 0 fail). Caller wired: cadence-core/workflows/milestone.md:68 names `no-version-field` in step 2's refusal halt list.

truths.truth: A `## ` line inside a fenced code block is not a section boundary for any heading scan in release-decision.mjs: prependChangelogEntry leaves the fence contiguous and promoteUnreleased moves the whole body.
truths.evidence: End-to-end through the seam, not just the unit: fixture CHANGELOG with an [Unreleased] body of bullet / ```markdown fence / `## [9.9.9] - inside a fence` / fence-close / trailing bullet above a real `## [1.0.0]`. After `release-bump.mjs bump --version 2.0.0 --date 2026-08-22` the file reads (cat -n) 3:`## [Unreleased]`, 5:`## [2.0.0] - 2026-08-22`, 7:bullet, 9:fence-open, 10:the fenced `## ` line, 11:fence-close, 13:trailing bullet, 15:`## [1.0.0] - 2026-01-01` - dated heading above the fence, fence contiguous, all five body lines promoted. Code: cadence-core/bin/lib/release-decision.mjs adds module-private `fenceScanner()`/`fenceMask()` (no node:fs import, so the file's no-I/O header holds) and routes every `^## ` scan through it - prependChangelogEntry's four anchors, promoteUnreleased's [Unreleased] and release-heading locators plus a re-mask after the splice, sectionEnd's next-heading scan, and releaseSectionEmpty's locator. Named tests pass: 'changelog: a `## ` line inside a fenced block is not a heading - the fence stays contiguous (D-09)' and 'changelog+promote: scaffolding then promoting puts the dated heading above the fence-open line, all five body lines between it and [1.0.0] (D-09)' in a 48/48 green `node --test cadence-core/bin/release-decision.test.mjs`.

truths.truth: A section body of only `###`/`####` subheadings reports section_empty:true and reaches the close's empty-section halt; a prose-only body with no bullets reports section_empty:false.
truths.evidence: Executed through the seam over two fixtures. Heading-only body (`### Added`, `### Fixed`, no bullets) -> {"ok":true,...,"changelog":{"changed":true,"promoted":true,"section_empty":true,"state":"ok"}}. Prose-paragraph body with no bullets -> "section_empty":false. D-04 holds: `promoted` is true in both, so the heading-only body still promotes and the halt fires off the field. Code: cadence-core/bin/lib/release-decision.mjs `releaseSectionEmpty` now skips blank lines and `/^#{3,4}\s/` only, returning false on any other non-blank line. Halt wired at cadence-core/workflows/milestone.md:84 (`changelog.section_empty: true`). Named tests green: 'promote: a body of only ###/#### subheadings reports sectionEmpty:true (D-03)', 'promote: a prose-only body with no bullets reports sectionEmpty:false (D-03)', and the pre-existing guard 'promote: sectionEmpty is false once content landed, true when the section stays bare' - the phase diff of release-decision.test.mjs contains zero deleted lines, so the three D-13 guards are unmodified.

truths.truth: An absent CHANGELOG.md, a present one that needed nothing, and a run that refused before the changelog gate return three envelopes distinguishable by a field VALUE, and milestone.md names the absent state.
truths.evidence: Three real runs: no CHANGELOG.md -> "changelog":{"changed":false,"state":"absent"} (ok:true); present-and-nothing-to-do -> "changelog":{"changed":false,"promoted":false,"section_empty":false,"state":"ok"}; refused before the gate (the no-version-field fixture) -> "changelog":{"changed":false,"state":"not-examined"}. Three distinct values, key present on all three. Emit sites cadence-core/bin/release-bump.mjs:276, :287, :303, :346, :388, :400, :407, :418. One test asserts all three in one place: cadence-core/bin/release-bump.test.mjs:458-483 ('bump: changelog.state tells the three states apart by VALUE, not by key presence (D-10)'), including `new Set(states).size === 3` and a key-presence loop; green in the 40/40 run. Value traced end to end: the literal `absent` emitted at release-bump.mjs:407 is the same literal milestone.md:84 halts on (`changelog.state: "absent"`), and milestone.md:84-89 tells the operator to STOP on it.

truths.truth: The trailing link-reference block is bounded by whether a key names an existing `## [key]` heading: a body-final `[#NN]: url` promotes with its section, a file-final `[1.0.0]: url` naming a real heading stays put, and both committed link-ref guards still pass.
truths.evidence: Two end-to-end seam runs. (a) File whose LAST section is `## [Unreleased]` with body `- closes [#87]` then `[#87]: https://git.example/issues/87`: after the bump the dated `## [2.0.0] - 2026-08-22` section carries lines 5 and 7 - both the bullet and the definition promoted, nothing stranded under the stub. (b) File-final `[1.0.0]: https://git.example/tags/1.0.0` whose key names an existing `## [1.0.0]` heading: it stays at file end (line 13), outside the promoted body. Code: cadence-core/bin/lib/release-decision.mjs `sectionEnd` walks up from the last non-blank line matching `^\[([^\]]+)\]:\s` and stops at the first key with no `## [key]` heading (heading pattern built through the module's `escapeRe`, fence-masked); the accepted edge is recorded in a comment at the rule. Guards green in the 48/48 run: 'promote: trailing link references stay put when [Unreleased] is the last section' and 'promote: a reference definition INSIDE the body travels with the content that cites it', plus the two new D-05 tests.

truths.truth: An unparseable --version refuses naming the raw argument, and a test derives the verdict-code set from executable `code:` literals and reddens when a code misses either document.
truths.evidence: `bump --dir <fixture> --version v` -> {"ok":false,"action":"refuse","reason":"unparseable-version","target":"v",...,"detail":"unparseable-version: the target version \"v\" is not semver, refuse to write"}, EXIT=1, fixture files md5-identical afterwards. `--version "  v  "` identical; `--version vv` still refuses as unparseable-version; absent --version still returns no-target-version with target:null; `--version "   "` still returns missing-flag-value. Code: cadence-core/bin/release-bump.mjs:264-265 (`const rawVersion = ...trim(); if (!target && rawVersion) target = rawVersion;`) with normalizeTargetVersion left unchanged per D-06. Code-set test: cadence-core/bin/prose-agreement.test.mjs:2257-2290, green. Falsified rather than trusted - re-ran its extraction and matching logic over mutated copies of the two sources in a scratch script: extraction yields exactly the seven shipped codes; blanking `downgrade` from the header copy and `not-an-upgrade` from the JSDoc copy each makes the assertion false; substituting a new `code: 'brand-new-code'` literal into decideManifestBump makes it extracted and named in neither document, i.e. the test reddens on an added code. The JSDoc half is present too: cadence-core/bin/lib/release-decision.mjs:186-187 now names all nine seam codes. Minor, not a gap and outside AC6's wording: `--version vv` reports target "v" (normalizeTargetVersion strips one leading v and the raw fallback only fires on an empty result), so the detail quotes a value one character off from what was typed - still a refusal, never a false green.
